design: Require E133 scalar predicted1-step progress AND E135 lambda1 predicted final paired task advantage. Same family-excluded OOF predictions; measured inputs only. Up to8 off actions in first accepted clean phase, then resume E120. No physics selector. No retraining or alternative penalties before selection.
selection: 20 fixed conjunction thresholds plus full abstention. Require zero E120 losses, maximize gains, fewer switches, larger task margin then motion margin. Adaptive fitting-validation selection after E133-E135; not unbiased performance.
held: Evaluate only qualifying nontrivial no-loss candidate after freezing all thresholds and all-fitting model fits. Previously used original held placements are development validation, not an independent final benchmark.
